# Root-reviewed prepare-only operator. Unreferenced review commit does not execute.
# A new, bounded entry may be published only after current shared-account/writer review.
# Does not revoke or renew any historical child. Cleanup must use this run's new receipt.
name: Issue 1505 fresh read-only Smoke GitHub preparation
on:
  push:
    branches: [ops/1505-smoke-github-readonly-20261109]
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/issue1505-smoke-github-readonly.yml
      - scripts/ops/issue1505/github-readonly-*.mjs
      - scripts/ops/issue1505/github-readonly.test.mjs
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: production-smoke-owner-acceptance
  cancel-in-progress: false
  queue: max
jobs:
  prepare:
    if: github.repository == 'alexj11324/Mikka' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/ops/1505-smoke-github-readonly-20261109' && github.run_attempt == 1
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency:
      group: web-deploy-production
      cancel-in-progress: false
      queue: max
    timeout-minutes: 15
    env:
      MIKKA_EDITION: cloud
      MIKKA_GITHUB_REPAIR_GO: 'root-reviewed-1505-github-http-v6'
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 2
      - name: Verify exact source, file scope, current main and bounded entry before credentials
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import datetime,hashlib,json,os,pathlib,subprocess
          root=pathlib.Path('.')
          assert os.environ.get('MIKKA_GITHUB_REPAIR_GO')=='root-reviewed-1505-github-http-v6'
          assert os.environ.get('GITHUB_REPOSITORY')=='alexj11324/Mikka'
          assert os.environ.get('GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT')=='1'
          assert os.environ.get('GITHUB_REF')=='refs/heads/ops/1505-smoke-github-readonly-20261109'
          assert datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)<datetime.datetime.fromisoformat('2026-11-09T13:40:00+00:00')
          def git(*args): return subprocess.check_output(['git',*args],text=True).strip()
          assert git('rev-parse','HEAD')==os.environ['GITHUB_SHA']
          assert git('rev-list','--parents','-n','1','HEAD').split()[1:]==['111a8dfb8b227ac0441324339ff42e4328ea609a','01ef3fa435380f23fbd3cd7cfbe77839cc5511d9']
          assert git('rev-parse','111a8dfb8b227ac0441324339ff42e4328ea609a^{tree}')=='6a06f3742fb0dfc35bed19780fe09da2747c1ddc'
          expected={"scripts/ops/issue1505/github-readonly-provider.mjs":"23a6f1098e66cddac71e76d6f9c9f41d5da0c3ba8bdf24c964cf4e7cece5851e","scripts/ops/issue1505/github-readonly-helper.mjs":"cdafa2f571ed898de2fc9d0a6f208cd3a0e53cfdc1d0777333cf755e73edb742","scripts/ops/issue1505/github-readonly-store.mjs":"1431219596ce2241f65f01df6642f0145c7f4c3b00f31181fefbc332ad9511d5","scripts/ops/issue1505/github-readonly-runner.mjs":"a94187ed60da64a0ef958de1186b2f51dae8f48f154de1895873e5ac351367fb","scripts/ops/issue1505/github-readonly.test.mjs":"293616146941d59d2196d7343899e1e9e24136ccab03e2025b59dd900e048994"}
          allowed=set(expected)|{'.github/workflows/issue1505-smoke-github-readonly.yml'}
          assert set(git('diff','--name-only','111a8dfb8b227ac0441324339ff42e4328ea609a','HEAD').splitlines())==allowed
          raw=git('diff','--raw','--no-renames','--abbrev=40','111a8dfb8b227ac0441324339ff42e4328ea609a','HEAD').splitlines()
          entries=[line.split('\t',1) for line in raw]
          assert len(entries)==len(allowed) and all(len(entry)==2 for entry in entries)
          assert {entry[1] for entry in entries}==allowed
          for header,path in entries:
              fields=header.split()
              assert len(fields)==5 and fields[0]==':000000' and fields[1]=='100644' and fields[4]=='A',path
          assert not git('diff','--name-only','HEAD')
          for path,want in expected.items():
              assert hashlib.sha256((root/path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==want,path
          import json,os,urllib.request
          class NoRedirect(urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler):
              def redirect_request(self,req,fp,code,msg,headers,newurl): return None
          request=urllib.request.Request('https://api.github.com/repos/alexj11324/Mikka/git/ref/heads/main',
              headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+os.environ['GH_TOKEN'],'Accept':'application/vnd.github+json'})
          with urllib.request.build_opener(NoRedirect).open(request,timeout=20) as response:
              assert response.status==200
              actual=json.load(response)
          assert actual['object']['sha']=='111a8dfb8b227ac0441324339ff42e4328ea609a','main_changed'
          assert datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)<datetime.datetime.fromisoformat('2026-11-09T13:40:00+00:00')
          print(json.dumps({'status':'passed','source':os.environ['GITHUB_SHA'],'base':'111a8dfb8b227ac0441324339ff42e4328ea609a','files':len(expected),'productDelta':False}))
          PY
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - name: Verify the exact bounded helper before loading production credentials
        run: node --test scripts/ops/issue1505/github-readonly.test.mjs
      - name: Install the existing application dependencies with frozen lock and normal scripts
        run: corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@10.34.3 --activate && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Recheck bounded entry and exact main after installation before production credentials
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import datetime
          assert datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)<datetime.datetime.fromisoformat('2026-11-09T13:40:00+00:00')
          import json,os,urllib.request
          class NoRedirect(urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler):
              def redirect_request(self,req,fp,code,msg,headers,newurl): return None
          request=urllib.request.Request('https://api.github.com/repos/alexj11324/Mikka/git/ref/heads/main',
              headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+os.environ['GH_TOKEN'],'Accept':'application/vnd.github+json'})
          with urllib.request.build_opener(NoRedirect).open(request,timeout=20) as response:
              assert response.status==200
              actual=json.load(response)
          assert actual['object']['sha']=='111a8dfb8b227ac0441324339ff42e4328ea609a','main_changed'
          assert datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)<datetime.datetime.fromisoformat('2026-11-09T13:40:00+00:00')
          PY
      - uses: Infisical/secrets-action@d2e351f16c6ca20d17c85e6c992e04bdeb64e87d
        with:
          method: oidc
          identity-id: 2cf9fa19-b9db-4c08-8ca0-b31859f2cbac
          oidc-audience: mikka-infisical
          project-id: 89850d6a-f020-4936-863e-df77380dfe40
          env-slug: prod

          secret-name: DATABASE_URL
          recursive: false
          include-imports: false
      - uses: Infisical/secrets-action@d2e351f16c6ca20d17c85e6c992e04bdeb64e87d
        with:
          method: oidc
          identity-id: 2cf9fa19-b9db-4c08-8ca0-b31859f2cbac
          oidc-audience: mikka-infisical
          project-id: 89850d6a-f020-4936-863e-df77380dfe40
          env-slug: prod
          secret-path: /vercel

      - uses: Infisical/secrets-action@d2e351f16c6ca20d17c85e6c992e04bdeb64e87d
        with:
          method: oidc
          identity-id: 2cf9fa19-b9db-4c08-8ca0-b31859f2cbac
          oidc-audience: mikka-infisical
          project-id: 89850d6a-f020-4936-863e-df77380dfe40
          env-slug: prod
          secret-path: /vercel
          secret-name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
          recursive: false
          include-imports: false
      - uses: Infisical/secrets-action@d2e351f16c6ca20d17c85e6c992e04bdeb64e87d
        with:
          method: oidc
          identity-id: 2cf9fa19-b9db-4c08-8ca0-b31859f2cbac
          oidc-audience: mikka-infisical
          project-id: 89850d6a-f020-4936-863e-df77380dfe40
          env-slug: prod
          secret-path: /vercel
          secret-name: GITHUB_CLIENT_ID
          recursive: false
          include-imports: false
      - uses: Infisical/secrets-action@d2e351f16c6ca20d17c85e6c992e04bdeb64e87d
        with:
          method: oidc
          identity-id: 2cf9fa19-b9db-4c08-8ca0-b31859f2cbac
          oidc-audience: mikka-infisical
          project-id: 89850d6a-f020-4936-863e-df77380dfe40
          env-slug: prod
          secret-path: /vercel
          secret-name: GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET
          recursive: false
          include-imports: false

      - name: Recheck current source and prepare one new read-only child using the normal Owner getter
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          NODE_ENV: production
          VERCEL_ENV: production
          BETTER_AUTH_URL: https://app.aspectlylabs.com
          NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL: https://app.aspectlylabs.com
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import datetime
          assert datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)<datetime.datetime.fromisoformat('2026-11-09T13:40:00+00:00')
          import json,os,urllib.request
          class NoRedirect(urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler):
              def redirect_request(self,req,fp,code,msg,headers,newurl): return None
          request=urllib.request.Request('https://api.github.com/repos/alexj11324/Mikka/git/ref/heads/main',
              headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+os.environ['GH_TOKEN'],'Accept':'application/vnd.github+json'})
          with urllib.request.build_opener(NoRedirect).open(request,timeout=20) as response:
              assert response.status==200
              actual=json.load(response)
          assert actual['object']['sha']=='111a8dfb8b227ac0441324339ff42e4328ea609a','main_changed'
          assert datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)<datetime.datetime.fromisoformat('2026-11-09T13:40:00+00:00')
          PY
          node --import ./tests/support/server-only.mjs --import tsx scripts/ops/issue1505/github-readonly-runner.mjs --prepare
      - name: Preserve the exact fresh receipt and any uncertain outcome
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: issue1505-github-readonly-fresh-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: issue1505-github-readonly-report/*.json
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
